description: This file defines the ReciprocalRankFusion class, which extends BaseDocumentCompressor to implement a document compression method that uses reciprocal rank fusion for re-ranking search results based on multiple queries generated by an LLM.

classes.name: ReciprocalRankFusion
classes.description: A class implementing reciprocal rank fusion for re-ranking documents based on multiple search queries generated via an LLM.

methods.name: compressDocuments
methods.description: Generates multiple queries from the input query, retrieves documents for each, and re-ranks them using reciprocal rank fusion.

methods.name: reciprocalRankFunction
methods.description: Re-ranks documents based on reciprocal rank fusion scores and returns the top K documents.
